servers.name: Weather Information Service
servers.description: Provides current weather, forecasts, and historical climate data for cities worldwide.
examples: What is the weather in London?
Get me a 5-day forecast for Tokyo

servers.name: Mathematical Calculator Service
servers.description: Performs arithmetic, scientific functions, statistical summaries, and unit conversions.

servers.name: Reference Data Lookup Service
servers.description: Looks up reference data about countries, currencies, and timezones.
examples: What is the capital of Japan?

servers.name: FAB Customer Intelligence MCP Server
servers.description: FAB customer intelligence layer. Answers questions about WHO a customer is — 360 profile, profitability, margin performance, RWA exposure, win/loss history, credit rating events, cross-sell opportunities, relationship discounts, and peer-group pricing benchmarks. Use for any query referencing a customer ID (CUST...) or customer-centric analysis.
examples: Show me the 360 profile for CUST001
What is CUST002's profitability and win rate?
servers.start_cmd: cd datalayer-as-service && MCP_SERVER_ID=fab-customer-server MCP_TRANSPORT=http MCP_HOST=127.0.0.1 MCP_PORT=9100 python -m mcp_server.customer_server

servers.name: FAB Pricing Engine MCP Server
servers.capability: FAB banking deal pricing and compliance
servers.description: FAB pricing engine layer. Answers questions about HOW to price a deal — pricing recommendations, step-by-step price builds, competitor offer comparisons, segment benchmarks, operational cost impact, and policy compliance checks. Use for any query referencing a deal ID (DEAL...) or pricing/compliance analysis.
examples: Which deals are non-compliant and why?
Explain step-by-step how the price was built for DEAL040
servers.start_cmd: cd datalayer-as-service && MCP_SERVER_ID=fab-pricing-server MCP_TRANSPORT=http MCP_HOST=127.0.0.1 MCP_PORT=9200 python -m mcp_server.pricing_server
